note: How the database structure is inferred from the SQL text found in the application's data-access code. Data only: extend a copy per project (no application names) and point the dotnet-api target option schemaInferRulesPath at it. Column types are decided by (1) the C# type of the value the code writes into the column, then (2) the first matching columnTypeHints pattern (case-insensitive, whole column name), else defaultType. Every type is marked inferred in SCHEMA_REPORT.md.
